# Hweat Penny

A wheat penny, pronounced with the h. One penny, one rotation, counted every
time it rolled on its way here.

- The page is a single route at `/`.
- The penny is one rotation (a nominal unit). The mirror mints a rotation id per
  verified answer.
- The numbers on the page were read from `scripts/lab/rotation.py`,
  `scripts/lab/cost.py` and `scripts/lab/penny.py` in the `kb` vault at build
  time — not invented.

## Invariants

- No navigation list: the page is one route.
- No analytics, no search index, no CMS: the stack is React + Vite + Tailwind v4
  + fancy-ui, served statically from GitHub Pages.
- The "h" in "hweat" is deliberate. There is a toggle that drops it.

## Build and verify

```sh
npm ci
npm run build
```
